# G30 — 3 m occupied sphere on clear-front lander legs

**Outcome:** the same visual language as G25 with the larger selected sphere.
Two legs flank the entrance; the rear leg, rear equipment and side arms keep
the central front bay free. Choose G30 instead of G25, not in addition to it.

Nominal centre is 1.700 m and sphere top **3.200 m (over 10 ft)**. A smaller
ground clearance and a different loop elevation follow from the larger radius;
neither is an occupancy approval. The six-foot ring and 1.8 m corner radius
are retained as study inputs only. The entrance now faces -Y.

| Step | Action | Required evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Andrew identifies a real 3 m product, its occupied/static-use instructions, delivered price and wet/dry mass. | Manufacturer manual, exact model and price; ZC-S30 replaces S25. |
| 2 | Measure inflated outer/inner dimensions, seams, entry and valve locations and the manufacturer's permissible support/contact areas. | Fit survey; illustrative 2 m inner diameter is not treated as a spec. |
| 3 | Tape the larger sphere and complete arm envelope; mark the clear front bay and trial the entry position without an unsupported person. | Full-scale access mockup; select a safe transfer/recovery design. |
| 4 | Reviewer redesigns/checks the contact loop, broad underside support, triangle and leg length for the actual 3 m product and payload. | G30-specific accepted drawing; G25 leg lengths and reactions are not copied. |
| 5 | Confirm top height, arms, crowd circulation and all ballast/ground-bearing space with placement. | Entire installed footprint and height submitted; no under-10-ft claim. |
| 6 | Quote the accepted parts, including freight/tax and heavier handling needs. Reconcile against $3,000. | Cost sheet includes actual sphere, support and selected optics; no assumed free rig. |
| 7 | Fabricate/inspect holder and detachable side/rear legs from the accepted drawing; mark front orientation. | Material and joint records plus measured finished mass. |
| 8 | Install support/ground protection and inflate the empty sphere under its instructions; check clearances and seam/contact behaviour through the allowed operating range. | Empty fit/leak inspection and demonstrated deflation recovery. |
| 9 | Fit selected LED/projection, capture and external haze modules. Validate the larger sphere's coverage with the actual lens. | Optical measurements, cable routing and updated load schedule. |
| 10 | Run reviewer-defined unoccupied tests, rescue rehearsal and crew training; resolve any failed check before occupancy. | Signed acceptance record and operating limits. |
| 11 | Confirm venue acceptance; conduct approved occupied rehearsal, observing entry, communication and seated comfort. | Operational release for the actual revision and location. |
| 12 | Pack, install, inspect nightly and strike under the shared field plan. | All parts accounted for, loans returned, damage logged. |

**BOM:** common rows + ZC-S30 + LANDER + one visual module. Never add both
sphere sizes or both alternate ring routes into the purchase total. A larger
sphere does not come with a proven larger occupant capacity.
